conceptZh: 兩台胖胖的玩具戰鬥機器人擺出超浮誇的對決架式，慢慢逼近、拳頭舉高——結果兩顆頭「叩」一聲輕輕撞在一起，兩台同時彈開坐倒在地，然後互相伸手把對方拉起來、握個手。
object: two chunky toy battle robots with soft rounded armour
morph: the glyph 戰 stands still as a solid sculpture while the harmless showdown gag plays out along its base
creativeAngle: 孩子指定的戰鬥機器人，但把對戰處理成完全無傷害的滑稽版：氣勢做到最滿，結果只是兩顆頭輕輕相撞後一起跌坐，收在互相拉起來的溫暖動作。戰左單右戈共十六畫，字體必須全程靜止才保得住結構。語音詞「戰車」，車ㄔㄜ已經學過，兩字都沒有破音。
promptEn: Create an exactly 8-second 3D stylized toy animation as one continuous locked-off shot on a clean solid pale peach background. One correctly formed Traditional Chinese character 戰 stands centered the whole time as a flat-fronted sculpture in saturated deep teal, filling about 70% of the frame height with comfortable margins on all sides. Use standard textbook proportions: the 單 component on the left, with its two top dots and stacked mouths clearly separated, sits beside the 戈 component on the right with its long slanting stroke, hook and dot. The glyph never moves, rotates, tilts or gets covered, and the camera stays locked. Along its base, two chunky toy battle robots with soft rounded armour face each other from opposite edges of frame, one teal and one orange. From 0.6 seconds they advance towards each other in slow, enormously dramatic strides, shoulder plates flaring, fists raised high, visors blazing with determination. The build-up is far too grand for the space available. At 2.2 seconds they meet in the middle, rear back for a mighty clash - and their heads simply go bonk, softly, like two plastic cups. Both freeze. At 2.8 seconds they topple backwards in perfect unison and land sitting down with matching surprised expressions and their fists still raised. Hold that beat. At 3.6 seconds each reaches out a hand, pulls the other up, and they shake hands with tiny polite nods before trotting out of frame in opposite directions by 4.7 seconds. From 4.8 to 8.0 seconds the frame is completely still and clean, holding on the single centered 戰 with nothing else in shot. Style: Pixar-like glossy chunky toy materials, soft studio lighting, bright high-contrast colors that are vivid but never neon, no dark or moody grading, no white blowouts. Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice speaks clear Taiwanese Mandarin and says exactly 「戰、戰、戰車」, using the reading ㄓㄢˋ for 戰 both on its own and inside the word. Speak the first 戰 around 0.5 seconds, the second around 2.0 seconds, and 戰車 around 5.6 seconds while the finished glyph is held still, with natural pauses, then stop; do not keep chanting the character or repeat the line. Keep every sound effect soft and clear of the voice, and use no music louder than the voice. The spoken word is audio only and must not be added to the picture. Keep the whole showdown gentle and silly: no weapons, no impacts that hurt, no scary faces and no loud startling sounds. The only writing anywhere in the frame is the single character 戰: no subtitles, no vocabulary text, no other letters, numbers, watermarks, scenery, extra props, particles, lens flare, motion blur on the glyph, or flashing effects.

conceptZh: 豬探長把超大放大鏡當盾牌，神氣地準備迎戰，卻被盾牌的重量拖得坐倒，大鼻孔還被放大給大家看。
object: An original stout cartoon detective pig wearing a checked deerstalker hat and carrying an absurdly oversized magnifying glass.
morph: The complete traditional glyph 戰 remains a rigid, front-facing sculpture while the pig performs a miniature mock-battle gag beside it. Its strokes never transform.
creativeAngle: 改用豬探長與巨大道具的失衡笑點：迎戰架式越威風，坐倒後被放大的鼻孔越滑稽。字形從頭完整呈現，左側單的頂部保留兩個清楚的口，修正舊稿把它們描述成點的問題。
promptEn:
Create an exactly 8-second stylized 3D cartoon animation in one locked-off frontal wide shot. Against a light butter-yellow background, place one correctly formed Traditional Chinese glyph 戰 at the center, filling approximately 70% of frame height with comfortable margins. Give its flat front a saturated deep blue finish and minimal extrusion. Use an accurate standard Traditional Chinese textbook glyph: 單 on the left and 戈 on the right, preserving the two distinct 口 forms at the top of 單, every interior gap, and the separate strokes, dot and hook of 戈. Keep the entire glyph stationary, sharp, uncropped and unobstructed throughout.

In the open lower-left margin, stage an original stout cartoon detective pig with a checked deerstalker hat, tiny determined eyebrows and an enormously oversized magnifying glass. Design the pig with rounded animated proportions and springy cartoon movement. The magnifying glass is his only prop; its lens is approximately as wide as his body. Leave enough space beside the glyph for the entire gag without crossing its silhouette.

At the opening, the self-important detective plants his feet and lifts the magnifying glass like a mighty battle shield, puffing out his chest toward an imaginary opponent off-screen left. By 1.2 seconds he has achieved a wonderfully grand defensive pose. Pause briefly as his proud smile turns into a strained wobble: the shield is much too heavy. From 1.8 to 3.1 seconds its weight pulls his arms downward, his feet make two frantic little recovery steps, and he plops gently onto his padded bottom. The glass rim settles upright on the floor directly between his snout and the camera. His eyes remain visible above the rim while the lens optically enlarges his pink snout into two enormous round nostrils. Keep this optical effect entirely within his side of the frame, away from the lettering. Hold the astonished nostril close-up for a short beat; he blinks, notices the ridiculous result, and gives a sheepish little grin. At 3.7 seconds he succeeds by lowering the oversized glass flat and sliding it away with both forelegs, then proudly shuffles after it. Both exit completely by 4.7 seconds. Hold only the complete centered 戰 perfectly still from 4.7 through 8.0 seconds.

Use soft studio lighting, bright non-neon colors and clear silhouettes. The miniature mock battle should feel playful and harmless. Add only a soft wobble squeak and a quiet padded plop, kept below the narration. A warm, friendly off-screen voice speaks clear Taiwanese Mandarin, saying exactly 「戰、戰、戰車」. Pronounce the first 戰 around 0.4 seconds, the second around 1.5 seconds, and 戰車 around 5.6 seconds, using ㄓㄢˋ consistently and natural pauses. Stop speaking after the word. Keep the finished glyph clearly visible during the word. The vocabulary is audio only. The single 戰 is the only on-screen writing; use no subtitles, logos, watermarks, additional text, clutter, flashing effects or background music.
